name: Lake Al'Ameth
summary: South of Dolanaar, Lake Al'Ameth's shores have grown dangerous as the plants turn violent. Once a quiet haven with little more than a wooden jetty, it is one of Teldrassil's largest freshwater lakes.

sections.title: A Troubled Shoreline
sections.body: Timberlings and timberling sprouts prowl the water's edge at Lake Al'Ameth. The lake lies just south of Dolanaar, where calm water and a sparse settlement give little hint of the danger ashore. An unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil has driven the plants into a frenzy. So druids and researchers from Dolanaar send travelers to gather seeds and kill the creatures before corruption spreads deeper into the forest.

sections.title: The Roots of Wrath
sections.body: Oakenscowl, once a noble timberling, now spreads corruption from a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. A gargantuan tumor has swollen his body, and other timberlings lash out at anyone who comes near. The woodland spirits have lost their balance. Now the Cenarion Circle faces an urgent test: can the rot around the lake be diagnosed and treated, and can Teldrassil's unblessed creation endure?

faq.answer: Lake Al'Ameth lies directly south of Dolanaar, the night elf settlement in eastern Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are the creatures around Lake Al'Ameth hostile?
faq.answer: A corrupting sickness afflicts Teldrassil's timberlings and other plant life along the shore. It drives once harmless woodland spriggans and treants into a territorial rage.

faq.q: What structures or landmarks are on the lake?
faq.answer: Lake Al'Ameth is largely wild and undeveloped. A simple wooden fishing jetty stands on its northern bank near the path from Dolanaar.

Oakenscowl is a corrupted timberling in a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern bank. Once a grand leader among his kind, he is poisoned by a gargantuan tumor and spreads corruption to the creatures that call the lake home.

angles.text: As a kaldorei of Dolanaar, you see Lake Al'Ameth's sickness as a warning of the troubles facing your newly raised home. Young defenders must protect the surrounding road.
As a druid, you can study the unnatural corruption undermining Teldrassil's flora and fauna in the wild timberlings around the lake.
